---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new certificate preset for this PKI suite
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g. I'm always frustrated when trying to issue a cert for ...).

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen, or what certificate preset/options should be supported.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Use Case / Target Service**
What service, appliance, or infrastructure component will use this certificate (e.g. FreeRADIUS, TrueNAS, MikroTik RouterOS)?

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, RFC references, or OpenSSL configuration snippets here.
